This bill is part of a package that would align definitions in the Export Inspection and Meat Charges Collection Act 1985 with those in the Export Control Act 1982 to allow the Department of Agriculture to recover costs for export services.
The bill would amend the Export Inspection (Service Charge) Act 1985 to fix technical defects and enable cost recovery for quota arrangements administered by other countries.
The explanatory memorandum describes the changes as minor and technical in nature.
